calculation.expression: (-sum(ret,3)) * (0.5 + clip(close/rolling_min(close,120)-1,0,3)) / (downside_std(ret,20)*sqrt(20)); set null when sum(ret,20) <= -0.35; cross-sectional median demean
calculation.description: Ranks assets for a short three-day rebound after a negative shock, amplified when price is above its 120-day floor and scaled by downside volatility. A deep medium-term collapse is excluded to avoid structural falling knives.

metrics.regime_notes: Only 653 dates met the minimum cross-section because the floor/trend gating leaves partial coverage. One-day IC narrowly clears the benchmark gate, but 5-day and 10-day IC are negative; 2035 YTD is positive but only 9 observations. Treat as a small, low-confidence tactical sleeve.

provenance.validation_note: Signals use only completed observations and forward returns are shifted strictly after signal formation.
